goal.objective: Activate the canonical StegVerse single-heartbeat runtime continuously on a StegVerse-owned or StegVerse-federated node using only node-local durable storage and native process supervision; third-party platforms may mirror source or validation evidence but cannot be required for deployment, scheduling, liveness, recovery, or worker leasing.
success_predicates: A StegVerse-owned or StegVerse-federated continuous carrier runs the canonical runtime
The carrier starts from already-present local runtime source or a StegVerse-distributed capsule without provider fetch dependency
Heartbeat, registry, event, cost, receipt, worker-coordination and canonical-checkpoint state survive carrier restart/replacement
Runtime v9 owns internal heartbeat cadence and carries worker-coordination subsignals every cycle
Worker lease lifetime is measured in canonical heartbeat cycles
Restart/replacement continuity preserves or increments the heartbeat epoch and creates no duplicate claim or fence
No external scheduler or process host owns worker activation
failure_predicates: Any third-party platform is treated as a required production dependency
A provider outage or quota is treated as a production activation blocker
The worker repeats observation-only failure without selecting or executing an alternate native activation path
A stateless or sleeping carrier is presented as durable activation without reconstructable state
A third-party scheduler becomes heartbeat cadence or worker activation authority
Carrier restart loses or forks canonical state

task.derivation_reason: Production activation must be StegVerse-native; unfinished work must remain actively worker-owned and solution-executing rather than entering an idle blocked state.

activation.recheck_trigger: each admitted heartbeat while unfinished; on a declared sovereign node the worker must execute native installation and proof production rather than merely observe missing evidence

completion.next_authorized_action: On the next admitted heartbeat, select or materialize an eligible StegVerse-owned/federated carrier, run the canonical native installer, observe heartbeat advancement, perform a controlled service restart, verify non-regression/no-duplicate claims and reconstruction, and consume the generated nine-predicate activation proof. If a candidate cannot satisfy the proof within the worker authority ceiling, derive/select the next eligible StegVerse-002 micro-node candidate or escalate the constraint collision to the next authority level; do not enter an idle blocked state.
terminal_when: A continuously executing canonical heartbeat carrier is active on a StegVerse-owned/federated node
Master Records reconstruction restores canonical state after restart/replacement
StegVerse-Labs/.github#12 sovereign activation predicates are all satisfied

constraint.problem_statement: The executable native activation and proof path is complete and hosted-validated, while no currently connected execution surface is directly observed as a declared StegVerse-owned/federated node.
solution_candidates: Bind the worker to any existing eligible StegVerse-owned/federated Linux, macOS, or Windows node
Promote an eligible StegVerse-002 micro-node to the carrier while preserving identical durability/restart/reconstruction predicates
Construct a new StegVerse-owned/federated node from the repository-local runtime capsule; no hosted provider is required
constraint.machine_observable_completion_condition: node-local activation.latest.json reports all nine sovereign runtime predicates true
constraint.escalation_rule: If all candidates collide with authority or physical constraints, derive an escalation task to the next authority level with the collision evidence and a concrete correction target.
